description: This file contains unit tests for the 'strbuf' data structure, testing its initialization, addition of characters and strings, and sanity checks on buffer consistency.

methods.name: void setup(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const void * data)
methods.description: Sets up an empty, initialized strbuf and runs a test function on it, then releases the buffer and checks that length and allocation are zero.

methods.name: void setup_populated(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
methods.description: Sets up a strbuf with initial string, runs a test function, then releases the buffer and verifies zero length and allocation.

methods.name: void assert_sane_strbuf(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Checks that a strbuf's internal buffer is non-NULL, NUL-terminated, and that 'len' is less than 'alloc' when 'len' is non-zero.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__static_init(void)
methods.description: Tests the static initialization of a strbuf structure, verifying zero length, zero allocation, and that the buffer's first character is NUL.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__dynamic_init(void)
methods.description: Tests dynamic initialization of a strbuf with a specific size, verifying sane internal state, zero length, proper allocation, and NUL termination.

methods.name: void t_addch(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Helper function that adds a character to a strbuf, asserting the buffer remains sane and length increases by one.

methods.name: void t_addstr(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Helper function that adds a string to a strbuf, asserting buffer sanity, correct length increase, and that the added string matches the buffer contents.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_char(void)
methods.description: Test case for adding a single character to an empty strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_empty_char(void)
methods.description: Test case for adding an empty character (effectively no change) to a strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_char(void)
methods.description: Test case for appending a character to a populated strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_str(void)
methods.description: Test case for adding a string to an empty strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_str(void)
methods.description: Test case for appending a string to a populated strbuf.

ctags.name: setup_populated
ctags.signature: (void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
